feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: See the Emmys 2026 red carpet looks
entry.summary: The 78th Emmy Awards are Monday night. See the stars as they arrived.

entry.title: Emmys 2026: Here's the list of winners
entry.summary: The Pitt and Widow's Bay took home the top prizes in television at the Emmy Awards on Monday night. And actor Matthew Rhys became the first person to win in two lead acting categories in one night.

entry.title: The Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail voting restrictions for this year's midterms
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election.

entry.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate after fall that led to an extended medical absence
entry.summary: McConnell spent weeks in recovery before explaining he was "briefly unconscious" following the fall that sent him to the hospital and a weeks-long recovery process.

entry.title: Texas landowners sue federal government over border wall plans
entry.summary: A lawsuit filed Monday takes aim at federal agencies' use of waivers to expedite construction of a wall along the border with Mexico and claims that landowner's constitutional rights are being violated.

entry.title: Federal agents may have broken state laws in voter fraud hunt, whistleblower claims
entry.summary: Federal agents may have broken state laws after the Department of Homeland Security began surging personnel for what it called the Unlawful Voter Initiative, a federal whistleblower alleges.

entry.title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
entry.summary: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.

entry.title: Kennedy Center says it's on the brink of bankruptcy, might close as early as Tuesday
entry.summary: In two board resolutions made public Monday, the arts institution says it is in a dire financial and physical state — and that only President Trump can "rescue" it.

entry.title: Bob Mackie, designer who dressed Marilyn Monroe, Elton John and Cher, dies at 87
entry.summary: The visionary costume and fashion designer was known as the "Sultan of Sequins" for his eye-catching celebrity looks.

entry.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
entry.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
